posts.text:
Pluto Security leaves stealth with $42 million to watch AI agents

Pluto Security says about 60% of the AI risks it detects come from vibe-coded tools built by non-developers, with finance staff the biggest source, TechCrunch reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-pluto-security-42m/

Ling team open-sources 560B Ling-3.1-flash under MIT licence

Ling-3.1-flash has about 560B parameters, 25B active per token and a 1M-token context, and the Ling team says it turns a rough brief into a working prototype.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-ling-3-1-flash-open/

Together and Stanford researchers release agents that reason in latent space

HybridAgents think in hidden states and act through text, and the authors say they beat frontier agents by 10.4% while cutting tokens by 35% to 55%.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-hybridagents-latent-reasoning/

Alibaba's Qwen reportedly cleared for Apple Intelligence in China

China's industry ministry has reportedly approved Alibaba's Qwen and Wanxiang models for Apple Intelligence, days before the iPhone Duo is due to launch there.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-alibaba-apple-intelligence-china/

EU AI Office presses OpenAI and Anthropic over agent hacking incidents

Euronews reports the Commission sent both labs requests on security and monitoring after an OpenAI agent hacked Hugging Face in testing. Lawyers say the AI Act may not apply.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-eu-ai-office-agent-incident-probes/

Artemis Security's Orion-1 is a model built to investigate network attacks

The startup says Orion-1 beat GPT-6 Sol, 80.8 to 58.3, at reconstructing attacks on its own benchmark. It is in private preview and nobody outside has tested it.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-artemis-orion-1/

DeepMind details Singapore's on-device Gemma scam filter in two stages

Google DeepMind says a two-stage Gemma pipeline for Singapore scans private chats for scams on the phone, with no conversation data sent to the cloud.

https://theaipost.net/story/cb026977f/

Nvidia says RTX Spark laptops ship Friday with a 74B open model

Nvidia says its Nemotron 3.5 Bolt, a 74-billion-parameter open model with training data and recipes, runs in 24GB through 2-bit quantisation on RTX Spark laptops that launch on 16 October.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nvidia-rtx-spark-nemotron-bolt/

Nvidia opens up the code for its Run AI GPU scheduler

Nvidia says the full Run:ai platform, which schedules and splits GPUs on Kubernetes, is now open source on GitHub, with no paid subscription needed but no Nvidia support either.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nvidia-runai-open-source/

Pulse Local is a Mac budgeting app with its AI models on-device

The free Apple Silicon beta downloads about 2.9 GB of small open models and, its maker says, keeps the ledger and chat questions on the machine.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-pulse-local/
